content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of pixels with an alpha value of 0. The original code zeroed out the RGB values when the alpha channel was 0, which is unnecessary and incorrect. Instead, the RGB values should be preserved even when the alpha is 0, allowing for proper transparency handling in the image processing. The patch corrects this by always setting the pixel values using the RGB values from the PNG data, regardless of the alpha value.
